name: chromatix-electron
description: A desktop music player for Plex.
author: Chromatix <hello@chromatix.app>

scripts.nodemon: npm run vars-set-local && nodemon --exec 'npm run dev2'
scripts.check: npm run knip && npm run lint && npm run prettier
scripts.draft-mac: npm run vars-set-local && node lib/run-timed.js electron-builder -m --config ./configs/electron-builder.mac-unsigned.js && npm run vars-reset
scripts.draft-win: npm run vars-set-local && node lib/run-timed.js electron-builder -w --dir --config ./configs/electron-builder.win.js && npm run vars-reset
scripts.draft-lin: npm run vars-set-local && node lib/run-timed.js electron-builder -l --dir --config ./configs/electron-builder.linux.js && npm run vars-reset
scripts.build-mac: npm run vars-set-prod && node lib/run-timed.js dotenv -- electron-builder -m --config ./configs/electron-builder.mac.js && npm run vars-reset
scripts.build-win: npm run vars-set-prod && node lib/run-timed.js dotenv -- electron-builder -w --config ./configs/electron-builder.win.js && npm run vars-reset
scripts.build-lin: npm run vars-set-prod && node lib/run-timed.js dotenv -- electron-builder -l --config ./configs/electron-builder.linux.js && npm run vars-reset
scripts.build-all: npm run build-win && npm run build-lin && npm run build-mac
scripts.ship-mac: npm run vars-set-prod && node lib/run-timed.js dotenv -- electron-builder -m -p always --config ./configs/electron-builder.mac.js && npm run vars-reset
scripts.ship-win: npm run vars-set-prod && node lib/run-timed.js dotenv -- electron-builder -w -p always --config ./configs/electron-builder.win.js && npm run vars-reset
scripts.ship-lin: npm run vars-set-prod && node lib/run-timed.js dotenv -- electron-builder -l -p always --config ./configs/electron-builder.linux.js && npm run vars-reset
scripts.ship-all: npm run ship-win && npm run ship-lin && npm run ship-mac
